description_for_human: Free 3D avatar and world generation with a free three.ws account, plus an optional paid API catalog for agents.
description_for_model: three.ws has two clearly separate surfaces, and every 3D request belongs on the free one. FREE, with a free three.ws account and nothing to pay: text-to-3D model and avatar generation at POST https://three.ws/api/3d/studio (OpenAPI https://three.ws/.well-known/3d-studio-openapi.yaml; send the account's API key from https://three.ws/dashboard/api-keys as Authorization: Bearer <key>, otherwise it answers 401 sign_in_required), the same generation lane over MCP at https://three.ws/api/mcp-studio (OAuth sign-in or the same API key), new models saved unlisted until their owner publishes them, the browser model viewer, the augmented-reality launcher at /api/ar, and the read-only market data endpoints indexed at /api/crypto. PAID and entirely optional: a separate catalog of 96 pay-per-call services under /api/x402/*, settled with the x402 protocol (HTTP 402, USDC on Solana and Base), covering market data, DeFi, news sentiment, agent infrastructure, and production 3D asset pipelines that go beyond the free lane. Prices and schemas: https://three.ws/.well-known/x402.json. Nothing in the free lane requires or accepts payment.
